import Mathlib

structure BipartiteGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BipartiteGraph.well_formed (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.size (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.has_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Prop :=
  colors.size = g.size ∧
  ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v →
    u < colors.size → v < colors.size → colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false

def BipartiteGraph.is_bipartite (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ colors, g.is_valid_coloring colors

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_precond (graph : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace BipCheck

/-- Undirected neighbourhood of `u`: successors of `u`, plus predecessors of `u`. -/
def symAdj (g : BipartiteGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList ++
    (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun w => decide (u ∈ g.adj.getD w #[]))

/-- The undirected edge relation. -/
def SymRel (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge u v ∨ g.has_edge v u

/-- `PathP g r w p` : there is a walk from `r` to `w` whose length has parity `p`. -/
inductive PathP (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat → Nat → Bool → Prop
  | refl (r : Nat) : PathP g r r false
  | step {r u v : Nat} {p : Bool} : PathP g r u p → SymRel g u v → PathP g r v (!p)

lemma symRel_symm {g : BipartiteGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : SymRel g u v) : SymRel g v u :=
  h.symm

lemma symRel_lt {g : BipartiteGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat} (h : SymRel g u v) :
    u < g.adj.size ∧ v < g.adj.size := by
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨h1, hwf u h1 v h2⟩
  · exact ⟨hwf v h1 u h2, h1⟩

lemma mem_symAdj_of_symRel {g : BipartiteGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat}
    (h : SymRel g u v) : v ∈ symAdj g u := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact List.mem_append_left _ (by simpa using h.2)
  · refine List.mem_append_right _ ?_
    rw [List.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨List.mem_range.2 h.1, by simpa using h.2⟩

lemma symRel_of_mem_symAdj {g : BipartiteGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : v ∈ symAdj g u) :
    SymRel g u v := by
  rw [symAdj, List.mem_append] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, by simpa using h⟩
    by_contra hu
    have hu' : ¬ u < g.adj.size := hu
    rw [Array.getD] at h
    simp [hu'] at h
  · rw [List.mem_filter] at h
    exact Or.inr ⟨List.mem_range.1 h.1, by simpa using h.2⟩

lemma pathP_cons {g : BipartiteGraph} {v u w : Nat} {p : Bool}
    (hs : SymRel g v u) (h : PathP g u w p) : PathP g v w (!p) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact (PathP.refl v).step hs
  | step h' hs' ih => exact ih.step hs'

lemma pathP_symm {g : BipartiteGraph} {r w : Nat} {p : Bool} (h : PathP g r w p) :
    PathP g w r p := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact PathP.refl r
  | step h' hs ih => exact pathP_cons (symRel_symm hs) ih

lemma valid_ne {g : BipartiteGraph} {c : Array Bool} (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hc : g.is_valid_coloring c) {x y : Nat} (hs : SymRel g x y) :
    c.getD x false ≠ c.getD y false := by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := symRel_lt hwf hs
  have hsz : c.size = g.adj.size := hc.1
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact hc.2 x y hs (by omega) (by omega)
  · exact fun e => hc.2 y x hs (by omega) (by omega) e.symm

lemma pathP_color {g : BipartiteGraph} {c : Array Bool} (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hc : g.is_valid_coloring c) {r w : Nat} {p : Bool} (h : PathP g r w p) :
    c.getD w false = xor p (c.getD r false) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => simp
  | step h' hs ih =>
      have h1 := valid_ne hwf hc hs
      revert h1 ih
      cases hcu : c.getD _ false <;> cases hcv : c.getD _ false <;>
        cases p <;> cases hcr : c.getD _ false <;> simp_all

/-- `cget col i` is the (optional) colour currently assigned to vertex `i`. -/
def cget (col : Array (Option Bool)) (i : Nat) : Option Bool := col.getD i none

lemma cget_set (col : Array (Option Bool)) (i : Nat) (hi : i < col.size) (x : Option Bool)
    (j : Nat) : cget (col.set i x hi) j = if j = i then x else cget col j := by
  by_cases hj : j < col.size
  · have h1 : j < (col.set i x hi).size := by simpa using hj
    simp only [cget, Array.getD, dif_pos hj, dif_pos h1]
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [if_neg h]
      first
      | (simp only [Array.getElem_set]
         split
         · omega
         · rfl)
      | exact Array.getElem_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ (Ne.symm h)
      | simp [Array.getElem_set_ne, Ne.symm h, h]
  · have hne : j ≠ i := fun h => hj (h ▸ hi)
    have h1 : ¬ j < (col.set i x hi).size := by simpa using hj
    simp only [cget, Array.getD, dif_neg hj, dif_neg h1, hne, if_false]

lemma cget_replicate (n i : Nat) :
    cget (Array.replicate n (none : Option Bool)) i = none := by
  by_cases h : i < n <;> simp [cget, Array.getD, h]

lemma getD_map (col : Array (Option Bool)) (u : Nat) (hu : u < col.size) :
    (col.map (fun o => o.getD false)).getD u false = (cget col u).getD false := by
  have h1 : u < (col.map (fun o : Option Bool => o.getD false)).size := by simpa using hu
  simp [cget, Array.getD, hu, h1]

/-- `u` and `v` lie in the same connected component. -/
def Conn (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop := ∃ p, PathP g u v p

/-- Colours assigned so far agree with walk parities inside each component. -/
def Inv (g : BipartiteGraph) (col : Array (Option Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v a b, cget col u = some a → cget col v = some b → Conn g u v →
    PathP g u v (xor a b)

/-- No edge leaves the coloured region. -/
def Closed (g : BipartiteGraph) (col : Array (Option Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, (cget col x).isSome = true → SymRel g x y → (cget col y).isSome = true

def pairsOf (g : BipartiteGraph) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).flatMap (fun u => (symAdj g u).map (fun v => (u, v)))

lemma mem_pairsOf {g : BipartiteGraph} {u v : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size)
    (hv : v ∈ symAdj g u) : (u, v) ∈ pairsOf g := by
  simp only [pairsOf, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩

lemma pairsOf_spec {g : BipartiteGraph} {q : Nat × Nat} (h : q ∈ pairsOf g) :
    q.1 < g.adj.size ∧ q.2 ∈ symAdj g q.1 := by
  simp only [pairsOf, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hu, hv⟩

lemma colored_of_path {g : BipartiteGraph} {col : Array (Option Bool)} (hcl : Closed g col)
    {y r : Nat} {p : Bool} (hy : (cget col y).isSome = true) (h : PathP g y r p) :
    (cget col r).isSome = true := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hy
  | step h' hs ih => exact hcl _ _ ih hs

lemma inv_set {g : BipartiteGraph} {col : Array (Option Bool)} {u v : Nat} {a : Bool}
    (hs : SymRel g u v) (hu : cget col u = some a) (hv : cget col v = none)
    (hvlt : v < col.size) (hinv : Inv g col) :
    Inv g (col.set v (some (!a)) hvlt) := by
  have key : ∀ y b, cget col y = some b → Conn g v y → PathP g v y (xor (!a) b) := by
    intro y b hy hconn
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconn
    have hconn' : Conn g u y := ⟨!p, pathP_cons hs hp⟩
    have h1 := hinv u y a b hu hy hconn'
    have h2 : PathP g v y (!(xor a b)) := pathP_cons (symRel_symm hs) h1
    have h3 : (!(xor a b)) = xor (!a) b := by cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  intro x y a' b' hx hy hconn
  rw [cget_set col v hvlt (some (!a))] at hx hy
  by_cases hxv : x = v
  · subst hxv
    rw [if_pos rfl] at hx
    have ha' : a' = !a := by simpa using hx.symm
    by_cases hyv : y = v
    · subst hyv
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hy
      have hb' : b' = !a := by simpa using hy.symm
      subst ha'; subst hb'
      have : xor (!a) (!a) = false := by cases a <;> rfl
      rw [this]
      exact PathP.refl _
    · rw [if_neg hyv] at hy
      subst ha'
      exact key y b' hy hconn
  · rw [if_neg hxv] at hx
    by_cases hyv : y = v
    · subst hyv
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hy
      have hb' : b' = !a := by simpa using hy.symm
      subst hb'
      have hconn' : Conn g y x := by
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconn
        exact ⟨p, pathP_symm hp⟩
      have h1 := key x a' hx hconn'
      have h2 : xor a' (!a) = xor (!a) a' := by cases a <;> cases a' <;> rfl
      rw [h2]
      exact pathP_symm h1
    · rw [if_neg hyv] at hy
      exact hinv x y a' b' hx hy hconn

lemma inv_set_root {g : BipartiteGraph} {col : Array (Option Bool)} {r : Nat}
    (hcl : Closed g col) (hr : cget col r = none) (hrlt : r < col.size) (hinv : Inv g col) :
    Inv g (col.set r (some false) hrlt) := by
  intro x y a' b' hx hy hconn
  rw [cget_set col r hrlt (some false)] at hx hy
  by_cases hxr : x = r
  · by_cases hyr : y = r
    · subst hxr
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hx
      have ha' : a' = false := by simpa using hx.symm
      subst hyr
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hy
      have hb' : b' = false := by simpa using hy.symm
      subst ha'; subst hb'
      simpa using PathP.refl r
    · exfalso
      rw [if_neg hyr] at hy
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconn
      have hys : (cget col y).isSome = true := by rw [hy]; rfl
      have hp' : PathP g y r p := by
        have := pathP_symm hp
        rwa [hxr] at this
      have := colored_of_path hcl hys hp'
      rw [hr] at this
      simp at this
  · rw [if_neg hxr] at hx
    by_cases hyr : y = r
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconn
      have hxs : (cget col x).isSome = true := by rw [hx]; rfl
      have hp' : PathP g x r p := by rwa [hyr] at hp
      have := colored_of_path hcl hxs hp'
      rw [hr] at this
      simp at this
    · rw [if_neg hyr] at hy
      exact hinv x y a' b' hx hy hconn

/-- The postcondition, stated so that the algorithm can carry its own proof. -/
def Good (g : BipartiteGraph) (r : Option (Array Bool)) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | some colors => g.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ g.is_bipartite

/--
Propagation-based two-colouring.  As long as some edge joins a coloured vertex to an
uncoloured one, the uncoloured endpoint receives the opposite colour (this is a
breadth-first traversal of the component).  When a component is exhausted, the next
uncoloured vertex seeds a new component.  Finally every edge is checked; a monochromatic
edge yields an even-parity walk between its endpoints, hence a contradiction for every
possible two-colouring.
-/
def solveAux (g : BipartiteGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (col : Array (Option Bool))
    (hsz : col.size = g.adj.size) (L : List Nat)
    (hL : ∀ i, i < g.adj.size → cget col i = none → i ∈ L)
    (hinv : Inv g col) : {r : Option (Array Bool) // Good g r} :=
  match hfe : (pairsOf g).find?
      (fun q => (cget col q.1).isSome && (cget col q.2).isNone) with
  | some q =>
      have hmem : q ∈ pairsOf g := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfe
      have hpred : ((cget col q.1).isSome && (cget col q.2).isNone) = true := by
        simpa using List.find?_some hfe
      have hpred2 : (cget col q.1).isSome = true ∧ (cget col q.2).isNone = true := by
        rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hpred; exact hpred
      have hspec := pairsOf_spec hmem
      have hs : SymRel g q.1 q.2 := symRel_of_mem_symAdj hspec.2
      have hvlt : q.2 < col.size := by
        have h := (symRel_lt hwf hs).2; omega
      have hvnone : cget col q.2 = none := Option.isNone_iff_eq_none.1 hpred2.2
      have hvL : q.2 ∈ L := hL q.2 (by omega) hvnone
      match hcu : cget col q.1 with
      | none => absurd hpred2.1 (by simp [hcu])
      | some a =>
          solveAux g hwf (col.set q.2 (some (!a)) hvlt) (by simpa using hsz)
            (L.erase q.2)
            (by
              intro i hi hnone
              rw [cget_set col q.2 hvlt (some (!a))] at hnone
              have hne : i ≠ q.2 := by
                intro h; rw [h, if_pos rfl] at hnone; simp at hnone
              rw [if_neg hne] at hnone
              exact (List.mem_erase_of_ne hne).2 (hL i hi hnone))
            (inv_set hs hcu hvnone hvlt hinv)
  | none =>
      have hcl : Closed g col := by
        intro x y hx hs
        by_contra hy
        have hy' : cget col y = none := by
          cases h : cget col y with
          | none => rfl
          | some b => rw [h] at hy; simp at hy
        have hxlt := (symRel_lt hwf hs).1
        have hmem : (x, y) ∈ pairsOf g :=
          mem_pairsOf hxlt (mem_symAdj_of_symRel hwf hs)
        have h := List.find?_eq_none.1 hfe (x, y) hmem
        simp [hx, hy'] at h
      match hfu : (List.range g.adj.size).find? (fun i => (cget col i).isNone) with
      | some r =>
          have hrmem : r ∈ List.range g.adj.size := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfu
          have hrlt : r < col.size := by
            have h := List.mem_range.1 hrmem; omega
          have hrnone : cget col r = none :=
            Option.isNone_iff_eq_none.1 (by simpa using List.find?_some hfu)
          have hrL : r ∈ L := hL r (by omega) hrnone
          solveAux g hwf (col.set r (some false) hrlt) (by simpa using hsz) (L.erase r)
            (by
              intro i hi hnone
              rw [cget_set col r hrlt (some false)] at hnone
              have hne : i ≠ r := by
                intro h; rw [h, if_pos rfl] at hnone; simp at hnone
              rw [if_neg hne] at hnone
              exact (List.mem_erase_of_ne hne).2 (hL i hi hnone))
            (inv_set_root hcl hrnone hrlt hinv)
      | none =>
          have hall : ∀ i, i < g.adj.size → (cget col i).isSome = true := by
            intro i hi
            have h := List.find?_eq_none.1 hfu i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
            revert h
            cases h2 : cget col i <;> simp
          match hfc : (pairsOf g).find? (fun q => decide (cget col q.1 = cget col q.2)) with
          | some q =>
              ⟨none, by
                show ¬ g.is_bipartite
                rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
                have hmem : q ∈ pairsOf g := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfc
                have hpred : cget col q.1 = cget col q.2 := by
                  simpa using List.find?_some hfc
                have hspec := pairsOf_spec hmem
                have hs : SymRel g q.1 q.2 := symRel_of_mem_symAdj hspec.2
                obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := symRel_lt hwf hs
                obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 (hall q.1 hq1)
                have hb : cget col q.2 = some a := by rw [← hpred, ha]
                have hpath : PathP g q.1 q.2 (xor a a) :=
                  hinv q.1 q.2 a a ha hb ⟨!false, (PathP.refl q.1).step hs⟩
                have hxa : xor a a = false := by cases a <;> rfl
                rw [hxa] at hpath
                have heq := pathP_color hwf hc hpath
                simp only [Bool.false_xor] at heq
                exact valid_ne hwf hc hs heq.symm⟩
          | none =>
              ⟨some (col.map (fun o => o.getD false)), by
                show g.is_valid_coloring _
                refine ⟨by simpa [BipartiteGraph.size] using hsz, ?_⟩
                intro u v he hu hv
                have hs : SymRel g u v := Or.inl he
                obtain ⟨hu1, hv1⟩ := symRel_lt hwf hs
                have hmem : (u, v) ∈ pairsOf g :=
                  mem_pairsOf hu1 (mem_symAdj_of_symRel hwf hs)
                have hne : ¬ (cget col u = cget col v) := by
                  simpa using List.find?_eq_none.1 hfc (u, v) hmem
                obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 (hall u hu1)
                obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 (hall v hv1)
                rw [getD_map col u (by omega), getD_map col v (by omega), ha, hb]
                simp only [Option.getD_some]
                intro e
                exact hne (by rw [ha, hb, e])⟩
  termination_by L.length
  decreasing_by
    · have h1 := List.length_erase_of_mem hvL
      have h2 : 0 < L.length := List.length_pos_of_mem hvL
      omega
    · have h1 := List.length_erase_of_mem hrL
      have h2 : 0 < L.length := List.length_pos_of_mem hrL
      omega

def solve (g : BipartiteGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) : {r : Option (Array Bool) // Good g r} :=
  solveAux g hwf (Array.replicate g.adj.size none) (by simp) (List.range g.adj.size)
    (fun i hi _ => List.mem_range.2 hi)
    (by
      intro u v a b hu _ _
      rw [cget_replicate] at hu
      exact absurd hu (by simp))

end BipCheck
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def check_bipartite (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (BipCheck.solve graph h_precond).val
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_postcond (graph : BipartiteGraph) (result : Option (Array Bool))
    (_ : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some colors => graph.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ graph.is_bipartite
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem check_bipartite_postcond_satisfied (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) :
    check_bipartite_postcond graph (check_bipartite graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact (BipCheck.solve graph h_precond).property
  -- !benchmark @end proof
